description: This file defines the class 'Article' for managing articles in the OpenCart CMS, including CRUD operations, descriptions, store associations, layouts, comments, ratings, and SEO URLs.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Encapsulates operations for managing articles within the OpenCart CMS, including CRUD, descriptions, store associations, layouts, comments, ratings, and SEO URLs.

methods.name: addArticle
methods.description: Creates a new article record in the database, including descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, and layouts, then returns the new article ID.

methods.name: editArticle
methods.description: Updates an existing article record and its related descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, and layouts.

methods.name: editRating
methods.description: Updates the rating of a specified article.

methods.name: deleteArticle
methods.description: Deletes an article and its related descriptions, store associations, comments, SEO URLs, and layouts.

methods.name: getArticle
methods.description: Retrieves a single article record by ID, including localized description data.

methods.name: getArticles
methods.description: Fetches a list of articles based on provided filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters, utilizing caching.

methods.name: getTotalArticles
methods.description: Returns the total number of articles matching specified filters.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a localized description entry for an article.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Removes all description entries for a specific article.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Removes all description entries associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a specific article.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions filtered by language ID.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates an article with a store.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes all store associations for an article.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves all store IDs associated with an article.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Associates an article with a layout for a specific store.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Removes all layout associations for an article.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes all article-layout associations for a specific layout.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Fetches all layout associations for an article.

methods.name: getTotalLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Counts how many articles are associated with a particular layout.

methods.name: editCommentStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (e.g., approved or pending) of a comment.

methods.name: editCommentRating
methods.description: Updates the rating of a comment.

methods.name: deleteComment
methods.description: Deletes a specific comment.

methods.name: deleteCommentsByArticleId
methods.description: Deletes all comments associated with a given article.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific comment.

methods.name: getRatings
methods.description: Retrieves rating statistics for an article, optionally filtered by comment.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Fetches comments based on various filtering criteria.

methods.name: getTotalComments
methods.description: Counts the total comments matching filter criteria.
